title: The Network - Growth & Network Health
description: The North Star view: does the network actually create value (mutual introductions), not just process mail. Built from thenetwork_introduction_transitions{action,consent_state}, the audit-derived counter over introduction.consent_transition events in thenetwork/introductions.py. Panels filter by action (propose/consent/decline/revoke), not consent_state alone - a clarify reply also emits a transition record carrying the proposal's current, unchanged consent_state, so filtering on consent_state alone would double-count against genuine propose/consent/decline/revoke transitions.

panels.title: Introductions completed (North Star)
panels.description: sum(increase(thenetwork_introduction_transitions{action="consent",consent_state="introduced"}[7d])). The core value-creation event: two people reached mutual consent and can now talk. This is the one number the team should watch to know whether the network is compounding.

panels.title: Introductions completed per day
panels.description: sum(increase(thenetwork_introduction_transitions{action="consent",consent_state="introduced"}[1d])) - the North Star trended daily, to see whether the network is accelerating.

panels.title: Introduction funnel (proposed / one-consented / introduced)
panels.description: Weekly counts by transition: sum(increase(thenetwork_introduction_transitions{action="propose"}[7d])) (proposed), action="consent",consent_state="one_consented" (one side accepted), action="consent",consent_state="introduced" (mutual - the North Star). Each stage should be read against the one before it.

panels.title: Introduction off-ramps (declined / revoked)
panels.description: sum(increase(thenetwork_introduction_transitions{action="decline"}[7d])) and action="revoke". Revoked (permanent, post-introduction) is a materially worse signal than declined (temporary cooldown, pre-introduction) - a rising revoke rate means introductions are landing but the matches are bad.

panels.title: Proposed -> introduced conversion rate (rolling 30d)
panels.description: sum(increase(...introduced...[30d])) / sum(increase(...propose...[30d])) - the mutual-match rate. Tracks whether match quality (not just proposal volume) is sustaining the loop; a falling rate while the North Star still grows means proposal volume is masking declining match quality.
